patterns.note: Content sections frequently use a central column for text and key information, flanked by imagery or presented within a grid of cards, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy.

A striking, elegant serif font is reserved for the main brand name and prominent display headings, creating a sophisticated feel that contrasts with a friendly, rounded sans-serif used for body text and subheadings.

A warm, inviting gradient transitioning from bright yellow to gold is used as a primary background for the hero and upper sections, shifting to a deep purple/blue for lower sections and the footer to create distinct mood changes.
The top navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid light grey background to become sticky, while the 'GET STARTED' button remains prominent.

A very large, stylized brand name ('Daylight') is positioned as a fixed background element that is dramatically revealed and hidden as foreground content scrolls over it, creating a strong parallax effect.
Major content sections are clearly delineated by significant changes in background color or gradient, often transitioning from the signature warm yellow to a darker, more muted purple/blue palette.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation bar that dynamically reduces its height and gains a solid background color as the user scrolls down the page.
The initial video hero section transitions to a static image strip or carousel once the user scrolls past the initial viewport, maintaining visual engagement without continuous video playback.

A large, stylized brand name is implemented as a background element that remains fixed in position, creating a dramatic parallax effect as foreground content scrolls over it, revealing or obscuring parts of the text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif display headings (up to ~4-5x body text) are paired with a clean, friendly sans-serif for body text and smaller headings, creating a sophisticated yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied consistently to buttons, input fields, and card elements, contributing to a friendly and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: A balanced to airy spacing is used throughout, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable margins around content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The distinctive use of a warm, inviting yellow-gold gradient as a primary background, combined with an elegant serif display font for the brand name and a dramatic background parallax effect where the brand name scrolls under content, sets this site apart from typical health service templates.
